predicted_sql: SELECT Property_Type_Description FROM PROP_TYPES WHERE Property_Type_Code  =  "real_estate"

question: What are the names of properties that are either houses or apartments with more than 1 room?
gold_query: SELECT property_name FROM Properties WHERE property_type_code  =  "House" UNION SELECT property_name FROM Properties WHERE property_type_code  =  "Apartment" AND room_count  >  1
predicted_sql: SELECT T1.property_name FROM properties AS T1 JOIN real_estate_properties AS T2 ON T1.property_id  =  T2.property_id JOIN Houses AS T3 ON T2.house_id  =  T3.house_id WHERE T3.rooms  >  1
